_note: Dialects that CANNOT render this scenario, each with a reason (FIXTURES.md 4.3). A renderable:false is an INVITATION TO CHECK THE REASON against observed output, not a settled fact.

otel_genai.reason: TWO INDEPENDENT BLOCKERS, and the chain one is NOT the binding one -- which is the second time this scenario's stated blocker has turned out to be the wrong one. (A) The binding blocker, measured at TASKS.md 2.16: s2.outputs is `absent` in otel_genai under EVERY candidate attribute, because the adapter reads neither gen_ai.retrieval.documents nor gen_ai.retrieval.query.text -- both of which the convention DOES define (opentelemetry-semantic-conventions 0.65b0) and neither of which this adapter consumes. FIXTURES.md 4.4 forbids setting a payload's `state` aside, ever, so no declaration can absorb this: absent != present is a real disagreement and must stay visible. Rendering it would require the adapter to learn two attributes, written from the convention registry with no captured retrieval or embeddings span anywhere in the repo -- exactly the reading-not-observation FIXTURES.md 5.1 forbids, and the defect that cost Phase 1 four fixtures. (B) The chain parent s0, for the same reason the other two scenarios carry. The previous reason had TWO grounds and one is now RETIRED BY OBSERVATION: a captured GenAI trace containing an invoke_workflow span exists (fixtures/captured/genai_workflow.jsonl, TASKS.md 2.15). The remaining ground is the one that always did the work, and it is untouched: mapping invoke_workflow to chain (SPEC.md 3.2, "a composite step with no more specific kind") is a JUDGEMENT rather than the name match every other OPERATIONS entry is. Three things now argue against taking it, and two are MEASURED rather than reasoned. (1) The invoke_workflow span in that capture is HARNESS-EMITTED, and structurally so: an instrumentor wraps SDK calls and a workflow is not one, so no instrumentor can ever emit one. The capture proves the value round-trips and that the adapter degrades honestly on it; it cannot say what a third party means by it, and capture/README.md's own sentence applies -- evidence about the outside world that you generated from your own idea of the outside world is not evidence. (2) Mapping it BREAKS unknown_kind[otel_genai], measured at TASKS.md 2.16: invoke_workflow is the adapter's ONLY unmapped convention value and is that scenario's specimen precisely because it is read from the registry rather than invented, so mapping it leaves otel_genai with no observed unmapped value at all. (3) SPEC.md 3.2 designates unknown + reported_kind as the first-class outcome for exactly this class, naming guardrail / reranker / router / handoff -- all composite-ish kinds a dialect invents. So this declaration is no longer "pending a capture"; it is pending a semantic decision about a closed vocabulary, and TASKS.md 2.16 carries it to a human with the rendering already written and verified. Note that (A) OUTLIVES the chain decision: mapping invoke_workflow to chain does not make this scenario renderable. 2.11 predicted the retriever would be the blocker and then recorded that it was the chain parent instead; the retriever IS also a blocker, one level down, at the payload rather than the kind. Do not retire this file with the other two.
